senses.gloss: m. ch. (v. next w.) paste, plaster, coating.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 43:9">Targ. Jer. XLIII, 9</cite> <he>טְפֵיל</he> constr. (h. text <cite ref="M01535"><he>מֶלֶט</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 74b:4">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>אי מעלי טִפְלֵיה</he> if its dough-paste is good.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:21">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>דשתי … בעיין בנתיה ט׳</he> because he drinks beer, his daughters need paste (to improve their complexion), v. <cite ref="I00661"><he>טְפַל</he></cite>.
